entities.summary: "Canned Heat" is the lead single from British funk group Jamiroquai's fourth studio album, Synkronized (1999). Released on 24 May 1999, it became their second number-one single on the US Dance Club Play chart and peaked at number four on the UK Singles Chart. The music video was directed by Jonas Åkerlund. The song is notably used in Napoleon Dynamite (2004).
